```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(autodep = TRUE)
proj_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("DESCRIPTION"))
setwd(proj_root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = proj_root)
pkgload::load_all(proj_root)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r helpers}
df_irs <- read_csv(here("data/IRS malaria Ahmedabad - IRS.csv")) |>
  janitor::clean_names()
df_cases <- read_csv(here("data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_2023.csv")) |>
  select(year, PF) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(cases = sum(PF))

df_join <- df_irs |> left_join(df_cases, by = "year")

# Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette, matching the manuscript figures
# (new_figures.qmd, parameter_profiles.qmd).
molecule_colors <- c(
  "Alphacypermethrin 5% WP" = "#0072B2", # blue
  "Lamdacyhalothrin 10% WP" = "#D55E00", # vermillion
  "Lamdacyhalothrin 10 CS"  = "#009E73"  # bluish green
)

#' Shared look for the IRS scatter/lm plots, matching the minimal theme used
#' across the manuscript figures.
theme_irs <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(family = "Helvetica")
    )
}
```

## Sprayed dwellings and % coverage vs. cases

Each point is one spraying round. Panels A-B pool all rounds together (one
fit, one Pearson correlation); panels C-D repeat the same two relationships
but group points, fit lines, and correlations by insecticide molecule.

```{r}
p1 <- df_join |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sprayed_dwellings, y = cases)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#0072B2", fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(color = "#0072B2", size = 2) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(aes(label = paste(after_stat(r.label), after_stat(p.label), sep = "~`,`~")), method = "pearson", color = "black", size = 3.3) +
  labs(x = "Sprayed dwellings", y = "Cases") +
  theme_irs()

p2 <- df_join |>
  ggplot(aes(x = percent_dwellings_coverage_under_irs, y = cases)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#0072B2", fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(color = "#0072B2", size = 2) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(aes(label = paste(after_stat(r.label), after_stat(p.label), sep = "~`,`~")), method = "pearson", color = "black", size = 3.3) +
  labs(x = "% dwellings covered", y = "Cases") +
  theme_irs()

p3 <- df_join |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sprayed_dwellings, y = cases, color = insecticide_molecule, fill = insecticide_molecule)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(aes(label = paste(after_stat(r.label), after_stat(p.label), sep = "~`,`~")), method = "pearson", size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = molecule_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = molecule_colors) +
  labs(x = "Sprayed dwellings", y = "Cases", color = "Insecticide molecule", fill = "Insecticide molecule") +
  theme_irs()

p4 <- df_join |>
  ggplot(aes(x = percent_dwellings_coverage_under_irs, y = cases, color = insecticide_molecule, fill = insecticide_molecule)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(aes(label = paste(after_stat(r.label), after_stat(p.label), sep = "~`,`~")), method = "pearson", size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = molecule_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = molecule_colors) +
  labs(x = "% dwellings covered", y = "Cases", color = "Insecticide molecule", fill = "Insecticide molecule") +
  theme_irs()

(p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(here("figures/irs_vs_cases.pdf"), width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 600)
```
